title: LONG-SHOT TARGETS: +700%, +636%, +527%, AND A +2,757% EXTREME. TARGETS, NOT PROMISES
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
These are the most extreme analyst-target write-ups published today.  
Several rest on just one or two analysts, one is a single-rating  
fallback, and one +2,757% gap is a stale-or-dilution warning as much  
as a bull case. Please read the flags.  
  
Here is the scorecard from today's write-ups.  
  
\*\*1. Terra Innovatum Global (NKLR)\*\* — The $16.50 central target is  
the average of just two recent targets — $8 from B. Riley and $25 from  
H.C. Wainwright, both October 2026. From about $2.05, reaching $16.50  
would take a gain of about 700%, huge even by micro-cap standards.  
Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/terra-innovatum-global-n-v-nklr-analyst-targets-point-to-potential-700-move-39376/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/terra-innovatum-global-n-v-nklr-analyst-targets-point-to-potential-700-move-39376/)  
  
\*\*2. Glass House Brands (GLAS)\*\* — The $9.50 target is the average of  
two October targets ($7 and $12). From about $1.29, reaching $9.50  
would take a gain of about 636%. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/glass-house-brands-glas-weighing-the-odds-of-a-636-move-to-the-9-50-analyst-target-39382/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/glass-house-brands-glas-weighing-the-odds-of-a-636-move-to-the-9-50-analyst-target-39382/)  
  
\*\*3. Capstone Energy+ (CEPL)\*\* — The $16.50 target is the average of  
two verified targets, $13 to $20. From a close near $2.63, that  
implies about 527% upside. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/capstone-energy-cepl-analyst-targets-average-16-50-implying-a-527-move-39397/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/capstone-energy-cepl-analyst-targets-average-16-50-implying-a-527-move-39397/)  
  
\*\*4. VENU\*\* — The $6.85 target is the average of two verified targets,  
$5.00 to $8.70. From about $1.10, reaching $6.85 would take a gain of  
about 520%. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/venu-stock-analyst-targets-point-to-520-upside-from-current-levels-39400/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/venu-stock-analyst-targets-point-to-520-upside-from-current-levels-39400/)  
  
\*\*5. Can Insight Molecular Diagnostics (IMDX)\*\* — The $10 target is  
the rounded average of three current targets ($8, $9, and $12). From  
about $1.86 after a sharp decline, reaching $10 would take a move of  
more than 400% (the write-up cites about 435%). Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/can-insight-molecular-diagnostics-imdx-hit-10-the-435-upside-question-39404/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/can-insight-molecular-diagnostics-imdx-hit-10-the-435-upside-question-39404/)  
  
\*\*6. SharonAI (SHAZ)\*\* — The $105 target matches an S&P Global average  
of six analysts, with a range of about $80 to $124. From about $20,  
reaching $105 would take a gain of about 420%. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/sharonai-holdings-shaz-analyst-target-of-105-implies-420-upside-potential-39351/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/sharonai-holdings-shaz-analyst-target-of-105-implies-420-upside-potential-39351/)  
  
\*\*7. Rare Earths Americas (REA)\*\* — The $26 target is the average of  
five verified targets: $12, $25, $28, $30 and $34. From about $5.62,  
that implies about 363% upside. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/rare-earths-americas-rea-exploring-the-path-to-a-26-analyst-target-363-upside-38471/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/rare-earths-americas-rea-exploring-the-path-to-a-26-analyst-target-363-upside-38471/)  
  
\*\*8. Red Cat (RCAT)\*\* — The $16 target is the average of seven current  
targets, ranging from about $6 to $25. From a November 16 close of  
about $3.53, reaching $16 would take a gain of about 350%. Target, not  
a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/red-cat-holdings-rcat-breaking-down-the-16-analyst-target-and-350-upside-path-39355/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/red-cat-holdings-rcat-breaking-down-the-16-analyst-target-and-350-upside-path-39355/)  
  
\*\*9. China Pharma (CPHI)\*\* — The $2.00 figure is a fallback from one  
verifiable analyst rating, not a multi-analyst average. The write-up  
still cites about 285% upside to $2.00. Target, not a promise — and  
coverage is extremely thin.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/china-pharma-holdings-cphi-assessing-the-path-to-2-00-and-its-285-upside-potential-38474/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/china-pharma-holdings-cphi-assessing-the-path-to-2-00-and-its-285-upside-potential-38474/)  
  
\*\*10. So-Young International (SY)\*\* — The $7.30 target is the average  
of two verified 12-month targets. From about $1.97, reaching $7.30  
would take a gain of about 270%. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/so-young-international-sy-assessing-the-270-path-to-the-7-30-analyst-target-39381/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/so-young-international-sy-assessing-the-270-path-to-the-7-30-analyst-target-39381/)  
  
\*\*11. TOYO\*\* — The $14 central target is the average of two October  
targets: $10 from Roth MKM and $18 from H.C. Wainwright. That average  
implies about 230% upside, per the write-up, and the range is wide.  
Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/toyo-stock-analyst-targets-signal-230-upside-potential-39383/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/toyo-stock-analyst-targets-signal-230-upside-potential-39383/)  
  
\*\*12. Infleqtion (INFQ)\*\* — The $20 target is the average of seven  
verified targets, rounded from about $19.57. From about $7.90,  
reaching $20 would take a gain of about 153%. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/infleqtion-infq-analyst-target-points-to-153-upside-potential-39337/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/infleqtion-infq-analyst-target-points-to-153-upside-potential-39337/)  
  
\*\*13. i-80 Gold (IAUX)\*\* — The $3.25 target is the average of two  
verified 12-month targets, rounded from $3.24. From a close of about  
$1.29, that implies about 152% upside. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/i-80-gold-iaux-152-upside-to-3-25-analyst-target-38521/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/i-80-gold-iaux-152-upside-to-3-25-analyst-target-38521/)  
  
\*\*14. Aligos Therapeutics (ALGS)\*\* — The $60 central target is the  
average of six verified targets. From about $2.10, Aligos would need a  
gain of about 2,757% to get there — a gap this large is a  
stale-or-dilution warning as much as a bull case. Target, not a  
promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/aligos-therapeutics-algs-60-target-would-require-2-757-gain-from-current-levels-38528/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/aligos-therapeutics-algs-60-target-would-require-2-757-gain-from-current-levels-38528/)  
  
When a target implies 500%+ upside, do you treat it as a research  
starting point, or as a red flag about coverage, share count, or stale  
numbers?  
  
Not financial advice. Figures are from today's (Nov 16) write-ups,  
using intraday or latest-close prices, not live quotes. Price targets  
are targets, not promises.
